text:
Type: deep three-seat sofa
Use: seating, lounging, napping; living room, den, lounge
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, chrome-plated metal legs
Colors: dark charcoal grey, silver
Shape: low wide seat platform, thin slab arms with rounded corners, loose back pillows and scatter cushions, slim metal legs, deep and relaxed
Feel: laid-back, casual, cozy, modern
Goes with: light grey walls, light wood, white or yellow accents; contemporary or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: SDERHAMN
product.description: The various sections of the seating series can be connected together in different combinations or used separately.
